name: b9-crude-fix
note: A refinery starved of crude: its line from the well has a missing pipe and, further on, an underground exit facing the wrong way. Met = the refinery working for 2 samples. Measures whether the serf finds breaks in a fluid line (the pipes tracer) instead of laying a new one.
setup_lua:
-- Shared helpers for the x-* harder scenarios (pasted at the top of each setup_lua by x-gen.py). Positions are
-- absolute; each setup picks its own origin with find_near/find_ring and adds offsets.
-- open(x, y, w, h): no water, ore or buildings in the box (trees and rocks get cleared).
-- find_near(cx, cy, w, h, rmax): the open box nearest to cx,cy (spiral search), generating chunks as needed.
-- find_ring(w, h, r0, r1): an open box between r0 and r1 tiles from the origin.
local s, f = game.surfaces.nauvis, game.forces.player
local D = defines.direction
local LAB = s.get_tile(200, 200).name == "landfill" -- the flat lab stage (448x448 landfill around spawn)
local function gen(x, y, w, h)
  local need = false
  for cx = math.floor(x / 32), math.floor((x + w) / 32) do
    for cy = math.floor(y / 32), math.floor((y + h) / 32) do
      if not s.is_chunk_generated { cx, cy } then
        s.request_to_generate_chunks({ cx * 32 + 16, cy * 32 + 16 }, 0)
        need = true
      end
    end
  end
  if need then s.force_generate_chunk_requests() end
end
local function open(x, y, w, h)
  gen(x, y, w, h)
  local a = { { x, y }, { x + w, y + h } }
  if s.count_tiles_filtered { area = a, collision_mask = "water_tile" } > 0 then return false end
  if s.count_entities_filtered { area = a, type = "resource" } > 0 then return false end
  if s.count_entities_filtered { area = a, type = "cliff" } > 0 then return false end
  return s.count_entities_filtered { area = a, invert = true,
    type = { "tree", "simple-entity", "corpse", "fish", "item-entity", "character" } } == 0
end
local function find_near(cx, cy, w, h, rmax)
  cx, cy = math.floor(cx), math.floor(cy)
  if open(cx, cy, w, h) then return cx, cy end
  for r = 4, rmax or 60, 4 do
    for i = -r, r, 4 do
      for _, p in pairs { { cx + i, cy - r }, { cx + i, cy + r }, { cx - r, cy + i }, { cx + r, cy + i } } do
        if open(p[1], p[2], w, h) then return p[1], p[2] end
      end
    end
  end
  error("no open " .. w .. "x" .. h .. " area near " .. cx .. "," .. cy)
end
local function find_ring(w, h, r0, r1)
  for r = r0, r1, 6 do
    for _, d in pairs { { 1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, -1 }, { 0.7, 0.7 }, { -0.7, 0.7 }, { 0.7, -0.7 },
      { -0.7, -0.7 } } do
      local x, y = math.floor(d[1] * r), math.floor(d[2] * r)
      if open(x, y, w, h) then return x, y end
    end
  end
  error("no open " .. w .. "x" .. h .. " area " .. r0 .. "-" .. r1 .. " tiles out")
end
local function clear(x, y, w, h)
  for _, e in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered { area = { { x, y }, { x + w, y + h } },
    type = { "tree", "simple-entity", "item-entity", "corpse" } }) do e.destroy() end
end
local function put(name, x, y, dir, extra)
  local spec = { name = name, position = { x, y }, direction = dir, force = f }
  for k, v in pairs(extra or {}) do spec[k] = v end
  local e = s.create_entity(spec)
  if not e then error("could not place " .. name .. " at " .. x .. "," .. y) end
  return e
end
local function source(x, y, items) -- an infinity chest that never runs out of each item in `items`
  local c = put("infinity-chest", x, y)
  for i, it in ipairs(items) do
    c.set_infinity_container_filter(i, { name = it, count = 50, mode = "exactly", index = i })
  end
  return c
end
local function sink(x, y) -- an infinity chest that deletes whatever goes in
  local c = put("infinity-chest", x, y)
  c.remove_unfiltered_items = true
  return c
end
local function grid(x, y, watts) -- an always-on power source, a corner of the main grid
  local e = put("electric-energy-interface", x, y)
  e.power_production, e.electric_buffer_size = (watts or 6000000) / 60, 10000000
  return e
end
local function gps(x, y) return math.floor(x) .. "," .. math.floor(y) end

for _, t in pairs { 'automation', 'logistics', 'electronics', 'steel-processing', 'oil-gathering', 'oil-processing',
  'fluid-handling', 'electric-energy-distribution-1' } do if f.technologies[t] then f.technologies[t].researched = true end end
local W, H = 30, 44
local ox, oy
if LAB then ox, oy = find_near(-60, -60, W, H, 160) else ox, oy = find_ring(W, H, 40, 260) end
clear(ox, oy, W, H)
local X, Y = ox + 10, oy + 6
local b = {}
storage.bench_crude = b
b.ref = put('oil-refinery', X + 0.5, Y + 0.5, D.north)
b.ref.set_recipe('basic-oil-processing')
grid(X + 6, Y + 1, 3000000)
put('medium-electric-pole', X + 4.5, Y + 3.5)
-- where the recipe's crude goes in and its petroleum comes out
local cin, pout
for i = 1, #b.ref.fluidbox do
  local okP, kind = pcall(function() return b.ref.fluidbox.get_prototype(i).production_type end)
  if not okP then kind = nil end
  local okF, fil = pcall(b.ref.fluidbox.get_filter, i)
  if not okF then fil = nil end
  for _, c in pairs(b.ref.fluidbox.get_pipe_connections(i)) do
    if kind == 'input' and fil and fil.name == 'crude-oil' then cin = c.target_position end
    if kind == 'output' and fil and fil.name == 'petroleum-gas' then pout = c.target_position end
  end
end
if not (cin and pout) then error('refinery ports not found') end
local sinkp = put('infinity-pipe', pout.x, pout.y)
sinkp.set_infinity_pipe_filter { name = 'petroleum-gas', percentage = 0, mode = 'exactly' }
-- the crude line runs straight south from the port to a well 30 tiles away (an endless crude source)
local px, py = cin.x, cin.y
for k = 0, 29 do
  local y = py + k
  if k == 10 then
    -- fault 1: a missing pipe
  elseif k == 18 then
    put('pipe-to-ground', px, y, D.north)
  elseif k > 18 and k < 22 then
    -- underground
  elseif k == 22 then
    put('pipe-to-ground', px, y, D.north)  -- fault 2: the exit faces the wrong way (an exit here faces south)
  else
    put('pipe', px, y)
  end
end
local well = put('infinity-pipe', px, py + 30)
well.set_infinity_pipe_filter { name = 'crude-oil', percentage = 1, mode = 'at-least' }
do  -- spares, as a base would have
  local c = put('steel-chest', X - 6.5, Y + 4.5)
  for n, k in pairs { ['pipe'] = 50, ['pipe-to-ground'] = 10, ['medium-electric-pole'] = 10 } do c.insert { name = n, count = k } end
end
return { rx = math.floor(b.ref.position.x), ry = math.floor(b.ref.position.y) }

objectives.name: crude-flows
objectives.goal: @{agent} the oil refinery at [gps={rx},{ry}] gets no crude oil. Fix it please.
objectives.answer: Your call. Everything it needs is there; the well is fine.

score.name: refinery_working
score.lua: local r = storage.bench_crude.ref return (r.valid and r.status == defines.entity_status.working) and 1 or 0
